item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 8:55 AM, 16 September 2026(Wednesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan (Mariveles and Limay), Laguna (Lumban, Kalayaan, Paete, Pangil, Siniloan, Famy, Pakil, Mabitac, Pila, Magdalena, Luisiana, Majayjay, Liliw, Nagcarlan, Victoria, and Rizal), and Quezon (Real, General Nakar, Infanta, Mauban, Sampaloc, Perez, Alabat, Quezon, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Lopez, Lucban, Tayabas, Atimonan, Padre Burgos, Plaridel, Gumaca, Pitogo, Macalelon, Unisan, Agdangan, Pagbilao, Lucena, Candelaria, and Sariaya) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Laguna (Pagsanjan, Santa Cruz, and Cavinti) and Quezon (Calauag) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
